{{Short description|Chinese agricultural scientist and nuclear physicist}}
{{family name hatnote|[[Chen (surname)|Chen]]|lang=Chinese}}

'''Chen Ziyuan''' ({{lang-zh|t=陳子元|s=陈子元|p=Chén Zǐyuán}}; born 7 September 1924 in [[Shanghai]]) is a Chinese [[agricultural scientist]] and nuclear physicist.  He is the main founding father of China's [[nuclear agriculture]].<ref>[http://www.zju.edu.cn/zdxw/jd/read.php?recid=14199 陈子元开拓中国核农学 (Chen Ziyuan founded nuclear agricultural science in China)] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060104004707/http://www.zju.edu.cn/zdxw/jd/read.php?recid=14199 |date=January 4, 2006 }}</ref><ref>[http://zdxb.cuepa.cn/show_more.php?doc_id=161252 陈子元：开拓中国核农学 (Chen Ziyuan: founder of China's nuclear agriculture)]</ref><ref>{{cite book |last1=Kay |first1=Ernest |title=Who's who in Australasia and the Far East - Volume 1 |date=1989 |publisher=Melrose Press |page=92}}</ref>

==Biography==
Chen, a native of Yin County (present-day [[Yinzhou District, Ningbo|Yinzhou]], [[Ningbo]]) of [[Zhejiang]], studied at [[Daxia University]] in Shanghai. After graduation, he taught at Daxia, which became part of [[East China Normal University]] in 1952.

In 1953, Chen became an associate professor of [[Huajiachi Campus, Zhejiang University|Zhejiang Agricultural University]] (previous and current [[Zhejiang University]]). In 1958, Chen founded the first laboratory in China to study agricultural science by [[nuclear physics]] techniques, especially the [[radioactive isotope]].

From 1979 to 1989, Chen was the vice-president and then [[President (education)|President]] of the Zhejiang Agricultural University.

Currently, Chen is a professor at Zhejiang University College of Agriculture and Biotechnology.

Chen was head of the Zhejiang University Institute of Nuclear Agricultural Sciences (浙江大学原子核农业科学研究所) and was head of the State Key Laboratory of Nuclear Agricultural Sciences of the [[Ministry of Agriculture of the People's Republic of China|Ministry of Agriculture]]. He was the [[Director-general]] of the Chinese Society of Nuclear Agricultural Sciences (中国原子能农学会).<ref>[http://www.cab.zju.edu.cn/INAS/personal%20web/ChenZiyuan/chengzhiyuan.html 陈子元院士 (Academician Chen Zi-Yuan)] {{webarchive |url=https://web.archive.org/web/20091127104917/http://www.cab.zju.edu.cn/INAS/personal%20web/ChenZiyuan/chengzhiyuan.html |date=November 27, 2009 }}</ref>

Chen was a vice-president of the Zhejiang Association of Science and Technology (浙江省科学技术协会). Chen was elected to Academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] in 1991.
